title: Spectral constants for algebraic numerical ranges
summary: We study spectral-set constants associated with the algebraic numerical range in unital Banach algebras. If $Γ_n$ denotes the universal constant for algebraic elements of degree at most $n$, then \[ Γ_1=1, \qquad 2n-1\leqslantΓ_n<\infty\qquad(n\geqslant2). \] Thus the algebraic numerical range is a spectral set with a constant depending only on the algebraic degree.
